method: Read-only registered-renderer source pointer declaration survey and original instruction crosschecks for demonstrated discrepancies.

findings.kind: QWORD double pointees translated as DWORD integer dereferences
Literal char pointers lost original byte-addressable representation

limits: Survey covers declared pointer types, including char/double locals and signature pointers, in the complete registered graph at this snapshot.
No short, float32, float10, undefined1 or undefined2 pointer declarations were present. Cast-driven accesses and generated stack struct layouts require separate native replay evidence.
No source changes were made by this audit. Sources can regenerate afterward; C hashes identify the reviewed snapshot.

A wider declaration survey also found 27 semantic Tact2010CString pointers and only the expected 32-bit int/uint/undefined4/code categories; no additional scalar pointee widths were present. CString pointers are modeled by the existing edition text service.
